detail.longDescription: We all have our reasons for loving Google Docs. (Mine is that it keeps my computer desktop clean—thanks for asking!) And while Google Docs isn't generally known for its looks, it has a whole load of features that help you add some flair to your documents. Unfortunately, Gemini for Google Docs can't help you with the aesthetic side of things (yet), so you'll have to do it manually.
